spans.s:
कौप कौप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कूप), coming
from a well or cistern; (अम्), n. well-water.

कौपीन, अम्, n. the pudenda; a privity, a privy
part; a small piece of cloth worn over the privities
by poor persons; a wrong or improper act, sin.
—कौपीन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has only a
piece of cloth over the privities.
कौप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, coming from a well or cistern.

कौपोदकी कौपोदकी, f. the mace of Kṛṣṇa,
= कौमोदकी; [also कौपादकी ?].
